audit_items.proof_trace: The validation function is missing the required check that startSlot >= minimum_request_epoch where minimum_request_epoch = max(current_epoch - MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS_REQUESTS, FULU_FORK_EPOCH). The TODO comment at line 134 confirms this is a known gap. The ByRoot handler implements this correctly (dataColumnSidecarsByRoot.ts:18-23, 42-49), proving the pattern exists but was not applied to ByRange.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker sends DataColumnSidecarsByRange P2P request with startSlot before minimum_request_epoch. Node accepts request, wastes resources querying potentially pruned data, violates spec requirement that peers MAY reject such requests with ResourceUnavailable per fulu/p2p-interface.md.
